content: PHP official 8.3 migration documentation warns of backward-incompatible changes that should be tested. The deprecated-features page says calling get_class() or get_parent_class() without arguments is deprecated in 8.3 and increment/decrement operators on certain non-numeric strings are deprecated; incompatible changes include stricter range() argument validation and warnings for empty string boundaries. Audit legacy helpers and run key plugin flows under PHP 8.3 with E_ALL enabled; PHP 8.2-only observations are diagnostic, not a target.
